title: SCP federation primitive — deprecations register
description: Tracks rules and other public surfaces in the deprecation ramp window. Every entry must elapse one MINOR release between announced_at and the target_release tag-cut per policies/VERSIONING.md (ii). Used by .github/workflows/release-gate.yml to refuse a tag-cut that would remove a surface before its window has elapsed. Closes WP-SCP-022 020H.1 TF-020H1-001 + WP-SCP-022 020C.1 TF-005.

deprecations.description: Active deprecation entries. Empty array = no surfaces in deprecation window. Entries are removed from this file once the surface has been removed in a tagged release.

surface_kind.description: Which public-surface category this deprecation covers (per policies/VERSIONING.md 'What counts as breaking'). 'tag_protection_pattern' added 020H.3 fix-round-1 to cover deprecations of v* / renovate/v* Repository Ruleset shapes (closes 020H.3 R1 COR-MAJ-002).

surface_id.description: Identifier of the surface being deprecated. For surface_kind=rule: SCP-R-NNN. For workflow_input: input name (e.g. 'rule-set'). For schema_field: dotted path (e.g. 'policy-check-summary.findings[].rule_id'). For annotation_title: SCP-EXXX. For branch_protection_helper_flag: --flag-name. For tag_protection_pattern: the ruleset pattern string (e.g. 'v*' or 'renovate/v*'). Closes 020H.3 R2 COR-nit-001.

announced_at.description: Date the deprecation was announced (the release that first emitted the deprecation warning).

announced_release.description: The release version that first emitted the deprecation warning.

target_release.description: The MAJOR release version where this surface is scheduled for removal. MUST be vX.0.0 — per policies/VERSIONING.md the MAJOR bump is the breaking-change vehicle. The release-gate workflow refuses any entry where target_release MINOR or PATCH is non-zero (closes 020H.3 R1 COMP-MAJ-001) AND additionally refuses a tag-cut where target_release matches the cut AND announced_release is not at least one MINOR behind. Closes 020H.3 R2 COMP-MIN-001 (schema-level enforcement of the workflow-level guard).

migration_pointer.description: Path or URL to the migration guidance — typically docs/reviews/rule-proposals/RULE-NNN.md (for rule deprecations) or a §M.N section of an ADR / DECISIONS.md row.

rationale.description: Optional one-sentence rationale for the deprecation. Adopters reading this file should understand the why.
